comparison_policy: Only same-10-case executable outputs are scored; paper numbers are not substituted.

methods.implementation: Shared OpenAI-compatible Alibaba Cloud Model Studio adapter
methods.notes: Uses the same frozen Qwen 3.7 Plus configuration as CADIR/SimpleCAD; the local credential file is Git-ignored.

Nine of ten cases produced strict-replay construction graphs plus STEP/STL/URDF. The public repository supplies the SDK and agent skill, but not the paper's five-agent orchestrator, learned retrieval encoders, or indexed case library; this is explicitly an SDK-conditioned baseline rather than a full paper reproduction.
The public GitHub repository contains the project website and viewer assets, but no runnable method implementation.
The arXiv record and paper describe the method, but no official runnable repository was verified during this audit.
